edits.old_string: It is a decision ask naming every open umbrella and every child in flight beneath it, at every depth. On the ruling it lands at once on its own branch, its diff operator-approved, through `crucible:finishing-a-development-branch`.
edits.new_string: It is a decision ask naming every open umbrella and every child in flight beneath it, at every depth, and asking whether the change takes a spec campaign or the operator's approval alone (umbrellas.md § Review). When the ruling is approval, or once the campaign it calls for has closed, it lands at once on its own branch, its diff operator-approved, through `crucible:finishing-a-development-branch`.

note: Binding-change paragraph: the decision ask now also asks whether the change takes a spec campaign or approval alone (umbrellas.md § Review), and landing waits for that campaign to close when one is ruled.
